about: Add-ons listed under Settings → Add-ons → Browse. Each entry points at a GitHub repository whose releases carry <id>.ptzaddon. Add yours with a pull request; only packages signed with the PTZ Controller release key show as verified.

addons.name: AI controller
addons.description: Talk to the booth: “cut to camera 2 in 5 minutes”. Your AI service, your key.

addons.name: Proclaim
addons.description: Next / previous, go to a service item, blank, and see what's on air.

addons.name: vMix
addons.description: Cut, fade, preview, tally and live status from vMix.

addons.name: Behringer WING
addons.description: Mute and unmute WING channels, every change read back. X32/M32 experimental.

addons.name: MIDI notes
addons.description: Sends a MIDI note per slide action, for software that listens for MIDI.

addons.name: HTTP API
addons.description: Each slide action is one web request you set up (ProPresenter and others).

addons.name: Simulated devices
addons.description: A practice switcher, slides and mixer that touch no real gear.
